## Participant submission

### Participant

- GitHub username:
- Submission folder: `participant_submissions/<github-username>/`

### Case decision

- [ ] Continue expansion
- [ ] Pause expansion
- [ ] Redesign expansion

### Required checks

- [ ] This pull request targets the `submissions` branch, not `main`.
- [ ] Only the existing Mokhles Group datasets were used.
- [ ] No external salary, labour-market or economic data was introduced.
- [ ] Raw source data was not modified.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data or unrelated binaries are included.
- [ ] Table grain and duplicate-count prevention are documented.
- [ ] Exactly three priority interventions are stated.
- [ ] Unsupported claims are excluded.
- [ ] Limitations and insufficient evidence are disclosed.
- [ ] The analysis can be reproduced from the included notebook or scripts.

### Deliverables

- [ ] Participant `README.md`
- [ ] Executive decision memo
- [ ] Analytical report
- [ ] Dashboard or preview
- [ ] Data-model diagram
- [ ] KPI dictionary
- [ ] Evidence register
- [ ] Reproducible notebook or script

### Summary

Describe the decision, strongest evidence and files included.
